response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, highly experienced software craftsman with strong systems, tooling, and full-stack breadth, but his recent and deep professional experience is overwhelmingly in TypeScript/Node.js, JavaScript, and D, with only incidental or old exposure to Java and no evidence of Kotlin, Spring, Quarkus, Hibernate, or IDE internals work. This mismatch against the role's core requirement of deep JVM/Java/Kotlin/Spring expertise makes him a weak fit despite his strong general engineering credentials.
strengths: Extensive, diverse senior/staff-level engineering experience across many domains and stacks
Demonstrated deep systems/tooling background (built test runners, web servers, CI infra, low-latency services)
Strong communication and teaching skills (workshops, talks, open source maintenance)
concerns: No recent professional experience with Java, and no evidence of Kotlin at all
No mention of Spring, Quarkus, Hibernate, or enterprise JVM frameworks
No demonstrated experience with IDE internals or language tooling for JVM languages

key_factors.factor: Strong general software craftsmanship and tooling background
